Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: Rasta Quest unarmed body animation authoring sheet, NOT a finished sprite export. Input image1: approved appearance reference; image2: detailed identity/clothing reference. Create one transparent 2 by 2 sheet, four distinct consecutive full-body RIGHT-FACING grounded axe-swing BODY poses at exactly the same drawing scale, same head size and planted floor. No axe or other weapon: a separate rigid axe will be composited into the closed near fist. Preserve black male face, thick tied-back dreadlocks, red yellow green band, cream sleeveless shirt with brown diagonal strap, red split sash, green pants, brown gold-buckled boots, wrapped forearms. Polished crisp premium pixel-art clusters, no blocky mannequin, no added jewelry, no glow/shadow/background/text. Pose1 already committed forward-strike with near fist extended chest-high ahead of body; pose2 forceful forward reach torso twist, near fist ahead at waist; pose3 descending follow-through fist ahead at hip; pose4 compact low follow-through fist ahead of thigh. Right-facing profile or slight three-quarter consistent with reference; NO back view. Keep upper arm anatomy plausible, fingers closed around an imaginary narrow shaft, far hand near abdomen not crossing near fist. Equal isolated 2x2 cells with broad transparent gutters, all hair/feet fully in cell, no duplicate poses. Same crown-to-soles scale in all cells, dynamic weight shift but no stepping far. No anticipation pose, attack is active from first frame. One coherent four-key swing sheet.
CRITICAL FIT CORRECTION: COMPACT AXE SWING, NOT PUNCHES. Both elbows remain BENT. Near gripping fist stays just one head-width ahead of sternum, at sternum height in key1 then waist key2 then hip key3 then thigh key4. Keep fist center no farther forward than front knee in every pose; near elbow beside ribs, forearm angled diagonally forward only a little. Narrower planted stance like idle reference. Do not draw fully outstretched straight punch arms. Enough empty space remains ahead for a full long axe. Body side profile must remain visible in all keys. Same compact scale and identity throughout.
air:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: Rasta Quest airborne axe-swing BODY authoring sheet. Input images are identity/style reference only. Create one transparent wide sheet of THREE equally spaced full-body RIGHT-FACING airborne melee swing poses at one shared drawing scale and head size, no weapon; a separate rigid axe will attach to closed near fist. Same black male face, tied-back thick dreadlocks with red/yellow/green band, cream sleeveless top, brown diagonal strap, red split sash with yellow trim, green pants, brown buckled boots, wrapped forearms. Preserve refined pixel-art style and deliberate clusters, never geometric placeholder. Pose1 airborne torso leans forward, knees bent, fist forward near shoulder; pose2 airborne extended attack, near fist forward waist high, legs staggered bent; pose3 downward follow-through near fist forward hip high, knees gathered for descent. Fists clearly separated from torso with empty space ahead for axe. All face right, no back view, no axe, no added symbols/jewelry, no motion trails, no effects, no ground/shadow/text. All hair and boots inside separate equal cells, broad transparent gutters. Three distinct connected action keys, body density consistent, actual transparent alpha. No landing/sitting pose.
CRITICAL FIT CORRECTION: compact bent-elbow swings, NOT airborne punches. Near elbow stays at ribs, gripping fist only one head-width ahead of sternum, not beyond front knee. Key1 near fist chest high; key2 waist high; key3 hip high. No straight fully extended arms, keep huge clear space ahead for independent axe. Preserve identical head and torso scale across all three keys.
